parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs (via assays.doc_id), and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL3717, standard_type IC50, and require both canonical_smiles and a PubMed ID or DOI (docs.pubmed_id or docs.doi). Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer DOI over PMID), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate.
